description: Source file implementing WiFi ZWDFS (Zero Wait DFS) functionality with initialization, start, stop, and deinitialization functions, including license and copyright information.

methods.name: wifiGen_zwdfs_init
methods.description: Initializes the ZWDFS FSM for a given radio, checking for bgdfs support.

methods.name: wifiGen_zwdfs_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the ZWDFS FSM for a given radio, stopping it if necessary.

methods.name: wifiGen_zwdfs_start
methods.description: Starts the ZWDFS process for a given radio, with an option for direct start.

methods.name: wifiGen_zwdfs_stop
methods.description: Stops the ZWDFS process for a given radio.
